End-to-end guide for a sister site or consortium hub starting from a fresh clone (or published container tag) and raw PCORnet extracts (0.36.0, M5/S5).

## 1. Check the runtime environment

Verify Python, DuckDB, pandas, PyArrow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, NumPy, R, and Quarto against the checked-in reference (`config/reference_env.json`):

```bash
python scripts/check_env.py
# Inside a release container:
python scripts/check_env.py --image ghcr.io/jkylearmstrong/omop-duck-db:0.36.0 --policy pinned
```

## 2. Raw PCORnet tables read by `etl_pcornet()` vs. post-build backfills

A sister site building from scratch with `omop-duck-db >= 0.36.0` (either Python `omop_etl.etl_pcornet()` or R `omopduckdb::etl_pcornet()`) gets all mapping, censored lab parsing, `VITAL.TOBACCO` fallback, and OMOP v5.4 `MED_ADMIN` domain routing in a single pass—**no post-build backfill is needed for a fresh build**.

If a site database was produced earlier or by an external builder, `omop_etl.backfill_all(con, raw_dir, dry_run=True)` audits and repairs all five historical gaps in a fixed order:

| PCORnet table / field | Target OMOP v5.4 table(s) | Fresh `etl_pcornet()` (`>= 0.36.0`, Py & R) | External / pre-0.36.0 DB backfill (`Python`, R `reticulate` wrapper) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DEMOGRAPHIC` (`PATID` / `SSID`) | `person` | Native (`DEFAULT_ALIASES`) | — |
| `ENCOUNTER` (`DISCHARGE_STATUS`, `OS` -> `581385`) | `visit_occurrence` | Native (`PCORNET_DISCHARGE_STATUS_CONCEPTS`, `data_cutoff="auto"`) | `backfill_discharge_status()`, `cap_observation_period()` |
| `DIAGNOSIS` (ICD-9-CM / ICD-10-CM / SNOMED) | `condition_occurrence`, `condition_era` | Native (dotless ICD + date-aware vocabulary fallback) | Step 1: `backfill_condition_concepts()` |
| `PROCEDURES` (CPT4 / HCPCS / ICD-9 / ICD-10-PCS) | `procedure_occurrence` | Native | — |
| `LAB_RESULT_CM` (`RESULT_NUM` + censored `RAW_RESULT`) | `measurement` | Native (`LAB_VALUE_SQL` + `LAB_OPERATOR_SQL` sets `operator_concept_id`) | Step 3: `backfill_lab_values()` (`.csv`/`.parquet`/`.zip`, `SSID` & `crosswalk.csv`) |
| `VITAL` (`HT`, `WT`, `BMI`, `SYSTOLIC`, `DIASTOLIC`, `SMOKING`, `TOBACCO`) | `measurement`, `observation` (`43054909`) | Native (`SMOKING` first, then `TOBACCO` `01`/`02`/`03` fallback) | Step 4: `backfill_vital_tobacco()` |
| `PRESCRIBING`, `DISPENSING` | `drug_exposure` + domain-routed tables, `drug_era` | Native + `route_drug_domains()` | Step 2: `backfill_drug_concepts()` + Step 5: `route_drug_domains()` |
| `MED_ADMIN` (`RX`, `ND`, `CH`/`CP`) | `drug_exposure`, `device_exposure`, `procedure_occurrence`, `observation`, `measurement` (`type = 38000180`) | Native + `route_drug_domains()` (`value_as_number = NULL` on `observation`/`measurement`, dose in `value_source_value`) | Step 5: `backfill_med_admin()` + `route_drug_domains()` + `repair_routed_med_admin_values()` |
| `LDS_ADDRESS_HISTORY` / `ADDRESS_HISTORY` | `location`, `person_address_history` | Native (5-digit ZIP zero-pad + unquoted-comma repair) | — |
| `ENROLLMENT` (optional) | `observation_period` | Native (`use_enrollment="auto"`) | — |
| `DEATH` (optional) | `death` | Native | — |

### Running `backfill_all()` on an externally built database

```python
import duckdb
from omop_etl import attach_central_vocabulary, backfill_all

con = duckdb.connect("omop_site.duckdb", read_only=True)
attach_central_vocabulary(con, "central_vocabulary.duckdb", temporary=True)
print(backfill_all(con, "path/to/raw_pcornet", dry_run=True))
```

## 3. Build each sister site's OMOP CDM database from raw PCORnet

```python
import duckdb
from omop_etl import build_schema, etl_pcornet

con = duckdb.connect("db/omop_site1.duckdb")
build_schema(con)
con.close()

etl_pcornet(
    source_dir="raw/site1",
    db_path="db/omop_site1.duckdb",
    central_vocab="db/central_vocabulary.duckdb",
    data_cutoff="auto",
)
```

## 4. Run the anonymous multi-site study and verify zero name leaks

Keep `site_names.txt` (one institution name or alias per line) and `labels.json` outside the shareable output directory:

```bash
python scripts/reproduce_study.py \
  --db-dir db \
  --out out/run_shareable \
  --private-dir private/run_work \
  --sites site1 site2 site3 \
  --labels-out private/labels_v1.json \
  --start 2017-01-01 --end 2022-09-30 \
  --profile ederri \
  --bootstraps 1000 \
  --names-file private/site_names.txt

python scripts/check_run_privacy.py \
  --dir out/run_shareable \
  --names-file private/site_names.txt
```

## 5. Re-issue under a fresh anonymous site-letter permutation (`relabel_study.py`)

To rotate `Site A..Site N` labels without re-extracting features or refitting models:

```bash
python scripts/relabel_study.py \
  --run-dir out/run_shareable \
  --out out/run_relabelled \
  --old-labels private/labels_v1.json \
  --new-labels random --label-seed 2 \
  --labels-out private/labels_v2.json \
  --names-file private/site_names.txt

python scripts/check_run_privacy.py \
  --dir out/run_relabelled \
  --names-file private/site_names.txt
```
